overview: ArthVeda Advisors advisory website with a self-service admin blog editor for publishing finance articles without code.
features: Internet Identity-protected admin editor at a hidden /admin URL
Create, edit, and delete finance blog articles with a rich text editor
Upload cover images from your computer for each article
Save drafts separately and publish when ready
Public blog, article pages, and homepage latest section read from the backend
Existing sample articles seeded into the backend on first deploy
